#include "cart_view.h"

END_MESSAGE_MAP()

void CartView::OnOpen()
{
    refresh();
}

int CartView::Total() const
{
    return 0;
}

TEST_F(CartTest, AddsItems)
{
    EXPECT_EQ(1, 1);
}

TEST_F(CartTest, RemovesItems)
{
    EXPECT_EQ(0, 0);
}
